name: Council of the Moonlit Faith
desc:
**Council of the Moonlit Faith** / **The Counsell** is the highest form of government in the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles). They ensure all operations within the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles) run smoothly. They work directly under [the Lady Confessor](entity:the_lady_confessor) and put all her decrees into action.

The Council consists of a handful of philosophical, theological, and academic members of the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles). All members of the Council are very religious and are apart of [The Moonlit Faith](faction:the_moonlit_faith).
